lines.line: Israel versus the USA. Twelve numbers.
One: size. Four hundred forty five Israels fit in America.
Two: thirty three times more Americans.
Three: so Israel is thirteen times denser.
Four: city dwellers. Israel ninety three percent, America eighty three.
Five: forest. A third of America. Israel, under seven percent.
Six: median age. Israel twenty nine, America thirty eight.
Seven: almost three kids per Israeli woman. America, one point six.
Eight: Israelis live four years longer.
Nine: money. America wins by thirty one percent.
Ten: Israel spends almost double on research.
Eleven: soldiers. Sixteen per thousand Israelis, plus forty five in reserve. America, four.
Israel drafts at eighteen. HAMAS and Hezbollah sit on its borders.
Twelve: Israel is the eighth happiest country. America, twenty third.
America is bigger and richer. Israel, younger and happier.
Which number surprised you? Part two is on my profile.
